notice: Fictional software-test scenarios only; no vehicle, VIN, listing, mileage, or price is verified or current market evidence.

cases.name: clearly-consistent
cases.purpose: CCC falls comfortably within a coherent historical range.

cases.name: potential-undervalue
cases.purpose: The coherent historical median is above the potential threshold but below the material threshold.

cases.name: material-undervalue-signal
cases.purpose: Five coherent historical observations place the median above the material threshold.

cases.name: one-high-outlier
cases.purpose: One expensive observation must not manufacture a discrepancy when the median supports CCC.

cases.name: one-low-outlier
cases.purpose: One low observation must not erase an otherwise coherent higher median.

cases.name: high-dispersion
cases.purpose: MAD divided by median is exactly the default 20 percent high-dispersion boundary.

cases.name: insufficient-count
cases.purpose: Two resolved independent observations are below the default minimum count.

cases.name: ambiguous-records
cases.purpose: Ambiguous identities are diagnostic issues and have no price observations.

cases.name: unresolved-records
cases.purpose: Unresolved identities are diagnostic issues and have no price observations.

cases.name: historical-out-of-provider-range
cases.purpose: Provider coverage is unavailable and must not be described as an empty historical market.

cases.name: current-only
cases.purpose: Current evidence remains explicitly current and cannot receive strong historical evidence strength.

cases.name: historical-and-current
cases.purpose: Sufficient historical evidence drives the primary result while contradictory current inventory stays separate.

cases.name: ccc-adjustments
cases.purpose: Advertised and CCC-adjusted comparable values remain distinct and the net effect is factual.

cases.name: mileage-differences
cases.purpose: Mileage differences are reported as facts without any dollar-per-mile adjustment.

cases.name: price-order-independence
cases.purpose: Reordering non-tied candidate inputs leaves Phase 3C ranks and the discrepancy result unchanged.

cases.name: price-selection-independence
cases.purpose: Changing only prices cannot change which first five ranked identities are selected.

cases.name: threshold-boundaries
cases.purpose: Compact below, exact, and above stimuli for every default policy threshold.

cases.name: currency-boundaries
cases.purpose: Cents, equality, signs, large values, and half-cent final rounding remain deterministic.
